target_customer: College students who pay a subscription for study help
problem: Students juggle generic chatbots, flashcard apps and notes tools that give quick answers without lasting understanding.

founders.name: David Yu
founders.background_notes: YC page says he taught AI to 1,000+ students in college and grew education content to 300M+ views.

founders.name: Soami Kapadia
founders.background_notes: YC page says his open-source repo from Groq has 900+ stars.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wraps large language models and speech around document and video ingestion, quiz generation and a voice tutor. Mostly application engineering on top of available models.

defensibility.rationale: Features such as summaries, quizzes and chat over uploads are offered by many tools, so differentiation is distribution to students and product polish.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General assistants and study tools added overlapping study features; no acquisition of YouLearn found.

market_need_then: Students already used ChatGPT, Quizlet and Notion together, and the founders cite that fragmented workflow; generative AI made automatic notes and tests feasible.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and encouraging, with taglines such as save hours, learn smarter

branding.community_and_virality: The CEO built an education content audience with a reported 300M+ views per the YC page, which is a distribution asset. Site claims 2,000,000+ learners, unverified. A similarly named India company, YoLearn.ai, can cause confusion.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name that is easy to say but generic, with no brand assets found; creator-led distribution mattered more than the name.

outcome_analysis: YouLearn is an active Spring 2025 company. Per its YC launch post it reached about 150,000 monthly users and grew revenue from 1K to 70K monthly in eight months, helped by the CEO's education content audience. Funding is not verified, and the market is crowded with general assistants, so the long run outcome is open.
notes: A single aggregator reports a 500K seed led by Y Combinator and Eight Capital Management as of June 2025; not confirmed by a primary source, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Traction figures (150K MAU, 70K MRR) are founder claims in the YC launch post. Aggregator figures of 2M users and 770K ARR unverified. Competitor list empty because no sources dated near the batch were found; launch post names ChatGPT, Quizlet and Notion as tools students used. Site claims differ on dates (a Fondo post dated 2026). The founding year 2024 follows a review source; YC page also says 2024 for peers but not verified here. Completeness pass: the 2025-06 seed of 500K rests on a single outlet (YesPress; another profile says Eight Capital co-led alongside YC's standard terms, so the lead is unclear). YoLearn.ai is a different company and not recorded.
